verdict.rationale: Terraform's core workflow (plan/apply/destroy/import/state) is CLI/config-first with machine-readable JSON output for every stage, verified in headless local probes (init→plan→apply→drift-check→destroy with no UI needed), and HashiCorp ships an official MCP server that gives AI agents direct programmatic access to docs/modules/policies, confirmed via a live JSON-RPC handshake.
